scope: Injected-font bold stand-in admission and the exact blob-id gate used by the CPU/GPU glyph forwarding painter. The stand-in duplicates a physical font blob under weight 700 only when every face in that blob is its family/style/width group maximum and all such maxima are <=500. Variable-weight fonts and blobs containing a real face above 500 receive no stand-in.

ordered_stages.command: MIRIFLAGS=-Zmiri-strict-provenance cargo +nightly-2026-10-17 miri test --locked --manifest-path verification/read-boundary/Cargo.toml bold_alias_boundaries

ordered_stages.domain: Four arbitrary u16 face weights and four arbitrary u16 group maxima, plus lengths 0..=4; independent oracle also checks unequal lengths.

ordered_stages.reason: The proven stand-in admission and painter blob-id gate operate on immutable slices/BTreeSet and local glyph arguments. No own threads, locks, atomics, async tasks or shared mutation exist; fontique registration and renderer synchronization remain third-party boundaries.

integration.cpu: native_font_synthesis 3/3: regular-only weights 600/700/900 select one synthesized frame with more ink than 400, real Bold is preferred when injected, and synthetic italic+bold both change the frame.
integration.gpu: native_font_synthesis with gpu-pending passes the synthetic italic and regular-only bold stand-in tests on the VM's software wgpu adapter; /dev/dri permission warnings do not fail rendering.
integration.stage_change: A 400->700 Style patch repaints a frame equal to a fresh 700 import because the retained source snapshot and rebuilt native candidate use the same font context/blob aliases.

TCB: fontique parsing, family/style/width queries, blob hashing and registration
Parley CSS face matching and shaping
pinned Blitz painter glyph embolden formula
Rust compiler, allocator and standard collections
limits: One physical blob is aliased as a whole because FontInfoOverride applies to every face it contains.
Fonts with a variable weight axis are not synthesized.
The Blitz relative embolden formula is copied as an explicit pinned third-party rendering policy; this report does not prove floating-point rendering geometry.
TextDisplayView currently has no font-weight update field, so its alias wiring is compiled but not exercised by a weight-changing display-client test.
